issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Naoma AI Demo Agent V2
products.tagline: Turns website traffic into booked, qualified meetings
products.summaryZh: 将网站流量转化为已预约的合格会议
products.descriptionZh: 你的预约演示按钮只能转化1-2%的访客，其余的都离开了。Naoma用一个AI客户经理取代表单，当场运行演示：它带领潜在客户浏览你的实时产品，回答问题，筛选资格并预约会议。它能记住回访的访客，从上次中断的地方继续，并将每次会话写回你的CRM。已为B2B SaaS团队运行了50,000多次演示。现在可自助使用：上传你的产品和知识库，今天就测试这个代理。
products.description: Your book-a-demo button converts 1-2% of visitors. The rest leave. Naoma replaces the form with an AI account executive that runs the demo right then: it walks the prospect through your live product, answers questions, qualifies them and books the meeting. It remembers returning visitors, picks up where they left off, and writes every session back to your CRM. 50,000+ demos run for B2B SaaS teams. Now self-serve: upload your product and knowledge base test the agent today.

products.name: Web Search Agents by Nimble
products.tagline: Self-learning agents automate web research + retrieval
products.summaryZh: 自学习代理自动化网络研究与检索
products.descriptionZh: 网络搜索代理是专为你的特定领域（公司信息丰富、法规研究等）打造的专家级网页抓取与研究代理。它们会自学你的使用场景，深入挖掘对你最重要的来源，为你的 AI 提供更深入、更相关的网络上下文。要开始使用，请将此链接提供给您的 AI：https://docs.nimbleway.com/agent-onboarding.md
products.description: Web Search Agents are expert web crawling and research agents for your specific domain (company enrichment, regulations research, etc.). They self-learn your use case to go deeper into the sources that matter most to you, giving your AI deeper and more relevant web context. To get started, give your AI this link: https://docs.nimbleway.com/agent-onboarding.md

products.name: Hello Inbox
products.tagline: Get more marketing emails into the inbox
products.summaryZh: 让更多营销邮件进入收件箱
products.descriptionZh: Hello Inbox 帮助营销团队让更多邮件进入收件箱，而不是被归入垃圾邮件。在发送前测试营销活动，了解哪些因素影响送达率，并获得明确的修复建议。Hello Inbox 不会向你抛出一堆送达率评分和技术数据，而是将结果转化为可执行的步骤，让你无需成为邮件送达专家，也能提升收件箱到达率。
products.description: Hello Inbox helps marketing teams get more emails into the inbox instead of spam. Test your campaigns before you send, see what is hurting deliverability, and get clear recommendations for what to fix. Instead of throwing deliverability scores and technical data at you, Hello Inbox turns the results into actionable steps so you can improve inbox placement without becoming an email deliverability expert.

products.name: Elva
products.tagline: Goodbye, Postman. Your APIs have new consumers
products.summaryZh: 再见，Postman。你的API有了新的消费者
products.descriptionZh: 开发者使用你的 API。现在智能体也在使用。Elva 从代码中发现 API，让你选择每个受众可以使用的内容，并通过认证和分析运行你的 MCP 服务器。跟踪智能体活动，并随着代码演进审查变更
products.description: Developers use your APIs. Now agents do too. Elva discovers APIs from code, lets you choose what each audience can use, and runs your MCP servers with auth and analytics. Track agent activity and review changes as your code evolves

products.name: Slashy Assistant
products.tagline: The AI assistant that does email for you
products.summaryZh: 为你处理电子邮件的AI助手
products.descriptionZh: Slashy 是一款 AI 原生邮件客户端，用于管理你所有的收件箱。Slashy Assistant 是内置于其中的 AI：它用你的语气起草回复、整理邮件、安排会议、准备简报并跟踪后续事项。连接你的日历、CRM、会议记录和常用工具，它会在五分钟内开始提供帮助。你可以在 Slashy 内使用它，也可以通过 iMessage、Slack 或电话使用。用自然语言设置自动化，Slashy 会主动处理重复性工作，无需你开口。
products.description: Slashy is an AI-native email client for managing all your inboxes. Slashy Assistant is the AI built into it: it drafts replies in your voice, organizes email, schedules meetings, prepares briefings, and tracks follow-ups. Connect your calendar, CRM, meeting notes, and favorite tools, and it starts helping within five minutes. Use it inside Slashy or through iMessage, Slack, or a phone call. Set up automations in plain English, and Slashy proactively handles recurring work before you have to ask.

products.name: Oats
products.tagline: Free, open-source, and on device meeting notetaker
products.summaryZh: 免费、开源且设备端的会议记录工具
products.descriptionZh: Oats 是一款完全开放、本地且免费的 AI 会议笔记工具。它设计为不干扰你的会议，无需机器人，本地运行时使用设备端 LLM 无需订阅。适用于 macOS 和 Windows。通过 ariso.ai 云后端提供增强转录、多语言支持、说话人识别、评估、辅导、自动跟踪后续事项等更多功能。
products.description: Oats is an AI meeting note-taking tool that is completely open, local, and free. Designed to not get in the way of your meetings, no bots, no subscription needed when running locally with on-device LLM. Available on both macOS and Windows. Enhanced transcription, multi-language support, speaker recognition, assessment, coaching, auto-tracking follow ups and more features via ariso.ai cloud backend.

products.name: Aside
products.tagline: AI browser that actually gets work done for you
products.summaryZh: 真正能为你完成工作的AI浏览器
products.descriptionZh:
Aside 是一款为人和智能体重新打造的浏览器。它能登录你的账户，直接使用网站，并完成复杂工作：消息、支付、内部工具，甚至本地文件。
- 每个细节都精心打磨：垂直标签页和 Liquid Glass。
- 在智能体浏览基准测试中达到 SOTA：表现优于 Claude Cowork。
- 完全隐私：一切都在本地运行并加密。
- 你可以使用自己的 Claude 或 ChatGPT 订阅。
products.description: Aside is a browser rebuilt for people and agents. It signs into your accounts, uses websites directly, and finishes complex work: messages, payments, internal tools, even local files. - Crafted in every detail: vertical tabs and Liquid Glass. - SOTA on agentic browsing benchmarks: outperforms Claude Cowork. - Full privacy: everything runs locally and is encrypted. - You can use your Claude or ChatGPT subscription.

products.name: AppZapper 3000
products.tagline: The uninstaller Apple forgot.
products.summaryZh: 苹果忘了做的卸载器。
products.descriptionZh: macOS 上最好玩的卸载工具已为31世纪重新打造。隆重推出 AppZapper 3000。拖入任意应用，即刻找出其所有附加文件。然后用真正的3D激光枪将它们删除。
products.description: The most fun uninstaller for macOS has been rebuilt for the 31st century. Introducing AppZapper 3000. Drag in any app and instantly find all of its extra files. Then delete them with a real 3D zapper.

products.name: OzBrain
products.tagline: Your knowledge shared with every AI agent & any teammate
products.summaryZh: 你的知识，与每个AI代理及任何队友共享
products.descriptionZh: 你的代理知识 Dropbox（无需你“操作”或维护即可运行。）你使用的每个代理都读写同一个大脑，你的队友及其代理也是如此。开启新对话，它就能知道你团队已经处理过的内容。你的知识产权、研究、科幻爱情小说或笔记都已加密，我不会用它们进行训练。可导出为 markdown，随时离开，因为我认为你的知识不应被锁在任何地方，包括 OzBrain。
products.description: Your Dropbox for agent knowledge (it works without you having to "work" it or maintain it.) Every agent you use reads and writes to the same brain, and so do your teammates and theirs. Start a new chat and it can know what you've all already worked on. Your IP, research, sci-fi romance novel or notes are encrypted and I won't train on it. Export it to markdown and leave whenever, because I think you shouldn't have your knowledge locked in anywhere, including OzBrain.

products.name: appdesigns
products.tagline: Design amazing appstore screenshots for free
products.summaryZh: 免费设计出色的应用商店截图
products.descriptionZh: appdesigns 是一款免费的浏览器内编辑器，用于制作 App Store 和 Google Play 截图。拖入你的屏幕截图，用最新的 iPhone、iPad 或 Mac 设备框起来，添加标题、背景和贴纸，然后按 App Store Connect 要求的精确尺寸导出。可以并排设计整套截图，倾斜和缩放设备，或从社区模板开始。无限次导出，无水印，无需账户即可开始。
products.description: appdesigns is a free, in-browser editor for App Store and Google Play screenshots. Drop in your screens, frame them in the latest iPhone, iPad or Mac, add headlines, backgrounds and stickers, and export at the exact sizes App Store Connect asks for. Design the whole set side by side, tilt and scale devices, or start from a community template. Unlimited exports, no watermark, and no account needed to start.

products.name: Image to ASCII
products.tagline: Make ASCII art for READMEs, Discord & creative visuals
products.summaryZh: 为README、Discord和创意视觉制作ASCII艺术
products.descriptionZh: 为你的 README 加上专属签名，为 Discord 添个吉祥物，或为下一篇博客文章配一张角色艺术封面。在浏览器本地将照片和标志转换为 ASCII——免费，无需注册，也不会上传图片。从内置示例开始，对比前后效果，调整预设、细节和颜色。复制文本或 Markdown；导出 TXT、PNG、SVG、HTML 或 ANSI。文本格式保留可编辑字符；图片导出保留视觉效果。试试霓虹水母，或制作一个 80 列的狐狸 README 标志。
products.description: Give your README a signature, your Discord a mascot, or your next blog post a character-art cover. Turn photos and logos into ASCII locally in your browser—free, with no signup or image upload. Start with a built-in example, compare before/after, and tune presets, detail and color. Copy text or Markdown; export TXT, PNG, SVG, HTML or ANSI. Text formats keep editable characters; image exports preserve the look. Try the neon jellyfish or make an 80-column fox README mark.

products.name: TryCase
products.tagline: AI tests your PRs. Get a video walkthrough before you merge.
products.summaryZh: AI 测试你的 PR。合并前先看视频演示。
products.descriptionZh: 打开一个 PR。TryCase 像真实用户一样使用你的应用，并将你的更改的视频演示以及测试结论直接发送回 GitHub。在合并之前查看发生了什么，支持多个 PR 并行测试。
products.description: Open a PR. TryCase uses your app like a real user and sends back a video walkthrough of your changes, plus a test verdict, right on GitHub. See what happened before you merge, with multiple PRs tested in parallel.

products.name: Afterglow
products.tagline: Run classic After Dark screen savers on modern macOS
products.summaryZh: 在现代 macOS 上运行经典 After Dark 屏幕保护程序
products.descriptionZh: Afterglow 在 macOS 上原生运行经典的 After Dark 屏幕保护模块——Flying Toasters、Fish!、Starry Skyline 等，无需 ROM。
products.description: Afterglow runs classic After Dark screen saver modules — Flying Toasters, Fish!, Starry Skyline, and more — natively on macOS, with no ROMs required.

products.name: Deplo
products.tagline: A simple-to-use alternative to cloud deployments
products.summaryZh: 一个简单易用的云部署替代方案
products.descriptionZh: 你熟悉的推送即部署，运行在你已经付费的机器上。无需 Docker。无需 SSH。无需账单。
products.description: Same push-to-deploy you already know, running on a machine you already pay for. No Docker. No SSH. No invoice.

products.name: Juggler
products.tagline: A visual AI coding harness
products.summaryZh: 一个可视化AI编码工具
products.descriptionZh: Juggler 是面向 AI 编程代理的桌面工作台。工具调用、审批、线程结构和原始上下文以 Finder 风格的分栏呈现。对话可分支为子线程。每个工具都是 JavaScript 插件。免费、开源、单个 Go 二进制文件。
products.description: Juggler is a desktop workbench for AI coding agents. Tool calls, approvals, thread structure and raw context are laid out in Finder-style columns. Conversations branch into sub-threads. Every tool is a JavaScript plugin. Free, open-source, one Go binary.

products.name: MemoryPet 2.0
products.tagline: Turn your browsers toolbar into an animated usage monitor
products.summaryZh: 将浏览器工具栏变成动态使用监控器
products.descriptionZh: MemoryPet 在你的 Chrome 工具栏里放了一只小小的动画宠物，它会根据系统内存或 CPU 使用率加速或减速，让你一眼就能直观、莫名满足地了解电脑的负载情况。2.0 版本在内存之外新增了 CPU 追踪、8 种新宠物、可悬停查看的使用率图表，以及完全关闭动画、只显示实时百分比徽标的方式。
products.description: MemoryPet puts a tiny animated pet in your Chrome toolbar that speeds up or slows down based on your system's memory or CPU usage, a glanceable, oddly satisfying read on how hard your machine is working. 2.0 adds CPU tracking alongside memory, 8 new pets, a hover-able usage graph, and a way to turn the animation off entirely and just watch a live percentage badge instead.

products.name: Marqly 6.0
products.tagline: Ask your bookmarks. Bring them to your AI.
products.summaryZh: 向你的书签提问。将它们带入你的 AI。
products.descriptionZh: 你的书签还能发挥更大价值。Marqly 6.0 新增 AI Assistant，可从你的收藏中给出回答；AI Organizer 会为你建议一个更整洁的收藏库供你审阅；MCP 则可将你保存的研究内容带入 Claude、ChatGPT 和 Cursor。文章、高亮、视频和 AI 对话都能集中保存。现已支持网页端、浏览器扩展和 iOS。Android 版即将推出。AI 功能包含在 Pro 中。
products.description: Your bookmarks have more to give. Marqly 6.0 adds an AI Assistant that answers from your saves, an AI Organizer that proposes a cleaner library for you to review, and MCP to bring your saved research into Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor. Keep articles, highlights, videos, and AI chats together. Available on the web, in your browser, and on iOS. Android is coming very soon. AI features are included in Pro.

products.name: Bluey Email - AI Email Marketing
products.tagline: Flat Pricing and AI Native Email Marketing
products.summaryZh: 统一价格与AI原生电子邮件营销
products.descriptionZh: Bluey 按发送的邮件计费，而非按存储的联系人计费，因此在你联系人突破 2.5 万的那天，账单不会随之上涨。营销活动、收据和 OTP 等事务性发送，以及带交易管道的 CRM，都集中在一个账户、一张账单上，而无需三家供应商。Composer 能根据一句话撰写整个营销活动。Grow 套餐为每月 30 美元，包含 5 万次发送和不限联系人数量。
products.description: Bluey bills for emails sent, not contacts stored, so your bill doesn't step up the day you cross 25K contacts. Marketing campaigns, transactional sends like receipts and OTPs, and a CRM with a deal pipeline live in one account on one bill instead of three vendors. Composer writes a whole campaign from one sentence. Grow plan is $30/mo for 50K sends with unlimited contacts.

products.name: LLMagnet
products.tagline: Make your WordPress site visible to AI
products.summaryZh: 让你的 WordPress 网站对 AI 可见
products.descriptionZh: LLMagnet 为 WordPress 网站提供 AI 可见性层。追踪来自 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 及其他 AI 爬虫的访问，衡量你的 AI 可见性评分，生成 llms.txt 和结构化数据，让你的网站对 AI 智能体可读且可操作。
products.description: LLMagnet gives WordPress sites an AI visibility layer. Track visits from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI crawlers, measure your AI Visibility Score, generate llms.txt and structured data, and make your site readable and actionable for AI agents.

products.name: OVO
products.tagline: Play music from files, iCloud & streams across Apple devices
products.summaryZh: 在Apple设备间播放来自文件、iCloud和流媒体的音乐
products.descriptionZh: OVO 是一款适用于 iPhone、iPad 和 Apple Watch 的高级音乐播放器。将本地文件、Apple Music、支持的 SoundCloud 内容、直播流和同步文件夹整合到一个专注的音乐库中。离线收听，通过 10 段均衡器调整播放效果，并通过 iCloud 在 iPhone 和 iPad 之间私密同步你的音乐库。
products.description: OVO is a premium music player for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Bring local files, Apple Music, supported SoundCloud content, live streams, and synced folders into one focused library. Listen offline, shape playback with a 10-band EQ, and privately sync your library between iPhone and iPad through iCloud.
